description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 3 (Landscaping), 5 (Materials) and 6 (Construction Management Plan) of planning permission ref. 68085/APP/2023/648, dated 26-04-2023 (Erection of a three storey building to create 2 x semi-detached dwellings with associated car parking and installation of vehicular crossover)
decision_conditions: In the absence of a submitted Ecological Enhancement Plan, the proposal fails to demonstrate how it will deliver measurable net gains and improvements for biodiversity in accordance with Paragraph 193 of the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF), Policy DMEI 7 of the Hillingdon Local Plan : Part 2 - Development Management Policies (2020), and the principles set out in the Environment Act 2021. As such the applicant has failed to comply with Part e) of Condition 3 attached to planning permission reference 68085/APP/2023/648.
